name: com.github.doqltl179.mu3library.addressables
description: Addressables management for Mu3Library: AddressablesManager wraps Unity's Addressables package to initialize it with a result, load and cache an asset, a list of assets, or a dictionary of assets by their primary keys under one key, query download sizes and download dependencies with progress, check for and update catalogs one call at a time, and release what a key loaded. Supports UniTask async variants when UniTask is installed. The Addressable Group Data Exporter drawer generates scripts of the labels, groups, and entries of the project's Addressable groups.
